Hi, I´m Johanna!
Nice To See You are Here.
intro.text:
I am a participatory researcher and collaborative designer.
With a BA in Social Science and Communications and a MA in Service Design, ....This portfolio showcases selected game-based and participatory research methods developed across different social, environmental, and cultural contexts. It demonstrates my experience in designing context-sensitive approaches that make complex systems tangible, facilitate dialogue among diverse stakeholders, and support collective exploration and experimentation to inform my research questions and translate insights into clear outcomes.

entries.title: Co-founder · ÜBERmorgen – Spiel um die Zukunft
entries.details:
- Co-developed ÜBERmorgen – Spiel um die Zukunft, an educational board game that enables dialogue on sustainability and future scenarios.
- Co-managed the project from concept to production, including game design, playtesting, balancing mechanics, visual development, crowdfunding campaign (€7k), manufacturing coordination and strategic partnerships.
- Implemented an impact-oriented distribution model, donating 300+ games to public institutions across Germany and engaging diverse audiences through conferences, festivals, and 15+ workshops.

entries.title: Innovation & Strategy · Central Services, Solutions Team (Internship)
entries.details:
- Conducted interviews, usability testing, and stakeholder workshops to identify user needs and translate insights into digital product requirements for internal and external projects.
- Designed user journeys, information architectures, and interactive prototypes for web and desktop applications, including a public-sector digital sports facility atlas, a tax assessment platform, and an employee management application.
- Researched emerging applications of AI and LLMs in UX/UI design and facilitated 12 workshops at KPMG's Prototyping Lab. [» Reference](#)

entries.title: Product Experience · Business Services Team (Working Student)
entries.details:
- Conducted user, product, and business research to inform PwC´s digital product experience strategy and improve service delivery.
- Designed UI/UX concepts, user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes using design systems for user-centered digital solutions, including PwC's Digital Store, an internal employee platform, an AI-powered knowledge management tool, and a public-sector digital platform supporting high-volume administrative processes. [» Reference](#)
